changes.title: Bounded shared-memory broadcast waits
changes.note: The stacked #68441, #68444 and #68445 replayed onto main d1ad1088bc: lost wake-up fix, bounded WFET/WAITPKG spin waits, and opt-in adaptive spin time. #68445 lists all three commits.

changes.title: b12x GB10 integration ported from local-inference-lab karmic-kraken
changes.note: One commit carries the fork's b12x path onto main: V2 runner, worker and engine-core preparation hooks; b12x paged attention, noncausal and GDN backends; Qwen4Exp b12x QSA, PLE, hyperconnection and MTP; PCIe/RoCE all-reduce; row-cache prefetch bridge and Prometheus relay; and upstream #65233, #65240 (MXFP4 CSF experts) and #67236 (NVFP4 draft lm_head on SM121) folded in. Dropped: recurrent boundary checkpoints, DCP-replicated hooks, adaptive-verification cost profiling, the b12x load format and the fork's ParallelLMHead quantization API.

changes.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Engram tables served from checkpoint files
changes.note: Extends main's Qwen4Exp engram-config disk_offload to DeepSeek V4.1: rows are read with preadv before graph replay, so the ~196 GiB of FP8 Engram rows take no device or pinned host memory on GB10.

changes.title: Rewrite flash_attn.cute imports to vllm.vllm_flash_attn.cute
changes.note: Packaging repair for this builder's symlink install path, which skips the import rewrite the upstream CMake copy performs. It carries no upstream change.

changes.title: GB10 DSV4.1 decode split policy
changes.note: Selects three DSV4.1 decode splits on the 48-SM GB10 (mla/kernel.py). The NVFP4 CSF scale-default commit is not carried: it edits a CSF policy function that exists only on local-inference-lab main, not on v0.7.4.

changes.title: CSF block and source readers from local-inference-lab main
changes.note: Adds b12x/loader/_csf_blocks.py and _csf_source.py verbatim; they depend only on stdlib, numpy and torch. vLLM's mxfp4_csf loader reads FP4-CSF containers through them.

changes.title: C S3-FIFO host row cache for disk PLE/Engram tables
changes.note: The twelve row-cache commits developed under local-inference-lab/flashinfer#44, replayed onto flashinfer-ai v0.7.4: the row-cache core, the caller-gated DiskTable.prefetch and host row-id helpers, and the prefetch telemetry commits. The upstream pull request later grew beyond these twelve; the lock carries exactly the audited set.
